name: Boise
tagline: Affordable Mountain Living in the Heart of Idaho
description: Boise offers an unbeatable combination of outdoor recreation, low crime, and a cost of living well below most Western US cities. The Boise Foothills are your backyard, the Boise River Greenbelt runs through town, and world-class skiing is just two hours away. Idaho's flat income tax and affordable housing make every FIRE dollar stretch further.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: High – consistently ranked among safest US cities
quickFacts.climate: Semi-arid with four distinct seasons; snowy winters and warm, dry summers

housing.description: Cheapest acceptable studio or older 1BR in the Central Bench, Morris Hill, or Garden City

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; casual brewpub and taco meals out occasionally

healthcare.description: ACA Silver plan via Your Health Idaho, subsidized if MAGI stays under the 2026 ~$62,600 400%-FPL cliff; assumes an early retiree (45–55) — older retirees budget more

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance — Boise is very car-dependent (Idaho auto insurance is cheap)

entertainment.description: Hiking the Foothills, Greenbelt biking, the library; an occasional movie night

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or older one-bedroom on the Bench or in Garden City, a paid-off car (Boise is very car-dependent, though Idaho insurance is cheap), and cooking at home most nights. The ACA Silver premium stays low only if MAGI is kept under the 2026 ~$62,600 subsidy cliff, and healthcare plus the car form a hard floor. Entertainment leans on free public land — the Foothills, the Greenbelt, nearby BLM trails. A simple, outdoors-focused life with real budget discipline.

housing.description: A typical 1BR in a solid neighborhood

dining.description: Dining out several times a week across Boise's 8th Street scene

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost low only if MAGI is managed under the cliff

transportation.description: A reliable AWD vehicle for winter driving, full coverage

entertainment.description: A Bogus Basin ski pass, mountain-biking gear, Treefort Music Fest, a gym membership

2M.lifestyle: A place in the tree-lined North End or a small home in West Boise, dining out several times a week on 8th Street, and a reliable AWD vehicle for winter roads. A Bogus Basin ski pass fits comfortably, and weekend trips to Sun Valley or McCall are within reach. Good coverage and a gym membership round out a comfortable, active life with room for a few trips a year.

housing.description: A high-quality 1BR or small home in the North End, Southeast Boise, or Harris Ranch

dining.description: Regular fine dining at Chandlers and The Avery; wine-tasting events

healthcare.description: A Gold plan; padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff where premium tax credits disappear

transportation.description: A late-model SUV for mountain roads, premium insurance, seasonal tires

entertainment.description: Multiple ski passes, fly-fishing trips, BSU season tickets, a golf membership

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality home in Harris Ranch or the North End with Foothills views, regular dinners at Chandlers and The Avery, and a late-model SUV for mountain roads. Premium coverage (padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff), a golf membership, BSU season tickets, and multiple ski passes all fit. Weekend fly-fishing and regular travel are easy. A genuinely affluent life by Boise standards.

housing.description: An upscale condo or a Foothills / Eagle luxury rental

dining.description: Fine dining several nights a week, wine-club memberships, catered gatherings

healthcare.description: An unsubsidized Gold/Platinum plan plus concierge / direct primary care

transportation.description: A luxury SUV plus a second vehicle

entertainment.description: Private ski lessons, heli-skiing trips, club memberships

domesticHelp.description: Weekly house cleaning, landscaping, snow removal

luxuryExtras.description: Sun Valley cabin weekends, quarterly travel, outdoor-gear upgrades

5M.lifestyle: A custom Foothills home or a large Eagle property, weekly housekeeping, and a luxury SUV. The best restaurants in town become a several-nights-a-week habit, healthcare is unsubsidized concierge-grade, and business class is the default for longer trips. Guided fly-fishing, private ski lessons, and Sun Valley cabin weekends all sit inside the budget, and Idaho's flat income tax keeps more of each withdrawal.

housing.description: A trophy Foothills home or a gated Eagle estate rental

dining.description: Private-chef dining and exclusive wine dinners

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized plan plus concierge medicine

transportation.description: A premium SUV with full ownership costs, plus regular private car service

entertainment.description: International ski trips, private river access, art collecting, major philanthropy

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeping several days a week plus grounds, snow-removal, and property upkeep

luxuryExtras.description: A Sun Valley second home, first-class international travel, ranch land

10M.lifestyle: A trophy Foothills property or a gated Eagle compound with acreage, household help several days a week, and occasional private-chef evenings alongside the best tables in town, with top-tier concierge medicine. Travel is first class, a premium SUV and car service handle getting around, and a Sun Valley second home is feasible. In a metro this size, roughly $207k a year puts one among the most comfortable residents, with real margin for giving and travel.
